notes.title: Toribash Next 1.2 - 27/01/24 Update
notes.notes:
This update features more bug fixes and minor improvements to Toribash Next:
Fixed crash after inventory load that was affecting some users
Fixed potential data parsing failure crashes while in Multiplayer
Fixed bug that was causing connection errors when attempting to join a new room after leaving multiplayer
Fixed UI bug that was leading to buttons in Play screen to retain pressed state
Fixed bug that was leading to incorrect currency display in ToriCoins purchase screen for some regions that use USD
Match intro tweaks to ensure correct info display after joining new room
Disabled "Disconnected" Play screen state due to redundancy as game client now instantly enters offline mode with last game state upon leaving online room
Updated X hotkey to enable Hold state by default instead of Relax

If you experience an issue that has not been addressed by this most recent update, please email a description to tbnsupport@nabistudios.com and we’ll check it out.

Thanks for any feedback! We greatly appreciate your support as we continue to refine and improve Toribash Next. Please check back here for more updates coming in the near future.

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.93 - 23/09/22 Update
notes.notes:
Changes in today's update:
Fixed bug with auto turn skipping in offline mode
Fixed bug with spawn position resetting to 0 when starting new game from Gamerules menu
Room list refresh fixes and mod display
Apply and New Game buttons in Gamerules menu will now be greyed out for players who can't use them
Auto hide chat input on match intro screen if it's your fight, keep it active and focused otherwise

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.91 - 09/09/22 Update
notes.notes:
Changes in today's build:
Added customizable mouse click and wheel scroll modes for character controls
New chat visuals with markdown support for bold, italics, underscore and strikethrough text

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.91 - 08/09/22 Update
notes.notes:
Updates in this build:
Backend changes to render scale - UI is now always drawn at native resolution
Added default head texture to use when player hasn't customized their own head yet
Press R while ghosting to play current fight up to current frame without triggering a full replay
Replaced chat status messages on saving mods/replays with UI popups
Fixed bug with notifications' dismiss button being unresponsive
Fixed bug with "Disconnected: None" error when opening room list
Fixed bug with game freeze on first launch
Fixes to ghost being a bit too opaque after last update

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.90 - 31/08/22 Update
notes.notes:
Updates in this build:
Settings menu with Graphics and Audio
Some graphics settings do not currently work
Menu buttons now become interactive earlier and don't wait for the whole menu / tab to finish loading
Added smooth transition to default head rotation in head customizer
Fixed bug with deactivated inventory items getting stuck on player preview
Fixed bug with cead customizer decal buttons becoming unresponsive

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.90 - 29/08/22 Update
notes.notes:
Updates in this build:
Added music composed by Matarika
Added buttons to load mod / replay from disk to browser menus
Updated joint state feedback to stand out better on darker joints
Updated bruising - self collisions and collisions that didn't generate score will no longer bruise bodyparts, player-environment collisions will only cause bruising if they have high enough magnitude
Fixed bug with notifications becoming undismissable
Fixed bug with native file browser not opening on macOS
Changed versioning scheme to major.minor.build
